brand_identity.name: Shri Ramya
brand_identity.target_audience: Women interested in premium ethnic Indian wear, traditional clothing enthusiasts, festive shoppers

core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix traditional Rajasthani aesthetics with modern minimalist layouts.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel like a royal welcome.
Content is King: High-quality product imagery is the hero; UI is the frame.
Negative Space: Use generous cream-colored whitespace to create luxury.
Contrast: Deep maroon against soft cream for dramatic elegance.
anti_patterns: No cramped layouts; let the fabric textures breathe.
No pure black (#000000) backgrounds; use rich dark browns or charcoals.

usage_rules: Use 'Playfair Display' for all major headings (H1-H3).
Use 'Manrope' for body text, navigation, and UI elements.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' in italics for brand story, quotes, or 'fabric details' sections.
Headings should never be bold (700+); stick to Medium (500) or Regular (400) for elegance.
Primary (Royal Maroon): Use for primary CTAs, active states, and key brand accents.
Secondary (Gold): Use sparingly for borders, icons, or subtle highlights (never large blocks).
Background (Cream): The main canvas. Avoid pure white (#FFFFFF) except for specific card backgrounds if needed for contrast.
Text (Charcoal): Use #1A1A1A for main text, never pure black.
Gradients: Avoid gradients. Use solid colors or subtle fabric textures.

grid_system.marketing: Bento Grid (Mode A) - Asymmetrical layouts for collections.
grid_system.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B) - Structured and clean.

rules: Mobile-First: Always design for mobile stack first.
Asymmetry: Use offset grids for the 'Lookbook' and 'Featured Collections' to break monotony.
Breathing Room: Add extra padding (py-24) between sections to mimic the pace of a luxury store.

shadcn_customization.radius: 0px (Sharp edges for a premium, tailored look) or 4px (very subtle)
shadcn_customization.shadows: shadow-sm (Subtle ambient) or none (Flat with borders)

specific_components.buttons: Sharp corners or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary: Maroon bg, White text. Secondary: Transparent bg, Maroon border.
specific_components.cards: Flat, no shadow, 1px border (#E6E0D4). Image takes up 80% of the card height.
specific_components.inputs: Underlined style (border-b only) or minimal box with light border.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay (opacity 0.03) on the background to give a 'paper' or 'fabric' feel.

motion.hover: Slow zoom (scale-105) on product images. Text color shift from Charcoal to Maroon.

visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (Light weight) or Lucide React (Thin stroke).

images.hero_treatment: Full-width or Split-screen with parallax effect.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Update 'tailwind.config.js' with the custom colors (Royal Maroon, Gold, Cream) and fonts.
3. FONTS: Import 'Playfair Display', 'Manrope', and 'Cormorant Garamond' from Google Fonts in 'index.css'.
4. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn for complex interactions (Dialog, Sheet, Form) but style them to match the 'Royal' aesthetic (remove default rounded-md, use sharp or subtle radius).
5. LAYOUT: Build the Home Page with a 'Hero' section (Parallax), 'Featured Collections' (Bento Grid), and 'New Arrivals' (Carousel).
6. PRODUCT PAGE: Focus on large images. Split screen layout: Left side = Scrollable Gallery, Right side = Sticky Product Details.
7. NAVIGATION: Create a 'Mega Menu' for categories (Sarees, Lehengas, etc.) with image previews.
8. MOCK DATA: Create a 'products.js' file with mock data using the provided image URLs to simulate the backend.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
